QuestInfo.summary: #b#p9072100##k is waiting for you in a number of towns... which is sort of creepy. Talk to him about his new weapon.

0.0: I'm Neville, and have I got something you're going to flip over? I do.

no.0: You don't believe me? You think I'm full of it?

yes.0: You noticed all the weird energy running through Maple World lately, right? Things are getting crazier and crazier every time we turn around. My employer thought we should be prepared.
yes.1: The weapons I stock show unparalleled strength in the hands of the right owners. How's that sound?
yes.2: I'm here to serve.\rCome find me when you've earned the right to purchase these new weapons.
